entries.headline: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Holds an 88 Metacritic Average
entries.summary: Star Wars: Galactic Racer has an 88 Metacritic average from 61 reviews, with 32 scores of 90 or above. It is scheduled for October 6 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

entries.headline: Narrative Exploration Adventure [AFANTASIA] Announced
entries.summary: Studio Sazanka announced its entry into publishing with [AFANTASIA], developed by noidnoidnoid. The narrative exploration adventure follows an amnesiac boy searching Tempo for clues to his memories. It is in development for Steam with no release date.

entries.headline: Co-op Tank-Building Roguelike Tower Tanks Announced
entries.summary: War Mouth Games announced Tower Tanks, in which players stack parts into a towering vehicle and move through its interior during combat. It supports solo play and local or online co-op for up to four players, with Steam Early Access planned for Q2 2027.

entries.headline: Jagex Announces New RuneScape MMO Under the Working Title RS4
entries.summary: Jagex announced a new RuneScape MMO built in Unreal Engine. The working title RS4 is set in Gielinor, beginning in Ashenfall, and is intended to stand alongside RuneScape, Old School RuneScape, and RuneScape: Dragonwilds. Platforms are unannounced and release is still years away.

entries.headline: Modern Warfare 4 Details Server Culling Anti-Cheat System
entries.summary: Activision and Infinity Ward detailed Server Culling, which withholds opponent-location data when players should not be able to see it, reducing information available to wallhacks. It is planned for every launch multiplayer map, Combat Outpost, Warzone, and future updates.
